# Load the dependency targets generated by Conan CMakeDeps.
find_package(ffmpeg CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(glm CONFIG REQUIRED)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)

set(AIPLAYER_CORE_SOURCES
    src/core/Player.cpp
    src/reader/Demuxer.cpp
    src/reader/FileReader.cpp
    src/decoder/AudioDecoder.cpp
    src/decoder/VideoDecoder.cpp
    src/sync/AVSynchronizer.cpp
    src/audio/AudioPipeline.cpp
    src/audio/AudioTempo.cpp
    src/audio/AudioRenderer.cpp
    src/video/VideoPipeline.cpp
    src/writer/AudioEncoder.cpp
    src/writer/VideoEncoder.cpp
    src/writer/Muxer.cpp
    src/writer/FileWriter.cpp
)

add_library(aiplayer_core STATIC ${AIPLAYER_CORE_SOURCES})

target_include_directories(aiplayer_core
    PUBLIC
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
    PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
)

target_compile_features(aiplayer_core PUBLIC cxx_std_17)

# Dependencies are implementation details of the player core.
target_link_libraries(aiplayer_core
    PRIVATE
        ffmpeg::ffmpeg
        glm::glm
        Threads::Threads
)

if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(aiplayer_core PRIVATE /W4)
else()
    target_compile_options(aiplayer_core PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
endif()

# Optional local libyuv checkout; default builds keep using FFmpeg conversion.
set(AIPLAYER_LIBYUV_SOURCE "" CACHE PATH "Path to an optional libyuv source checkout")
if(AIPLAYER_LIBYUV_SOURCE)
    set(LIBYUV_DISABLE_JPEG ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    add_subdirectory("${AIPLAYER_LIBYUV_SOURCE}" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/libyuv" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
    target_include_directories(aiplayer_core PRIVATE "${AIPLAYER_LIBYUV_SOURCE}/include")
    target_compile_definitions(aiplayer_core PRIVATE AIPLAYER_HAVE_LIBYUV=1)
    target_link_libraries(aiplayer_core PRIVATE yuv)
endif()
